name: Seedance 2.0 Reference
description: ByteDance's most advanced reference-to-video model. Generate video from up to 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio clips with native audio and cinematic camera control.

action.description: ByteDance's most advanced reference-to-video model. Generate video from up to 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio clips with native audio and cinematic camera control.
action.name: bytedance/seedance-2.0/reference-to-video

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Use 16:9 for landscape, 9:16 for portrait/vertical, 1:1 for square, 21:9 for ultrawide cinematic, or auto to infer from the input image.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

bitrate_mode.description: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.
bitrate_mode.title: Bitrate Mode

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds. Supports 4 to 15 seconds
duration.title: Duration

enhance_prompt.description: Rewrite your prompt with AI before generating, tuned for reference-to-video, for cleaner results.
enhance_prompt.title: Enhance Prompt

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated or not.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the desired motion and action for the video.
prompt.title: Prompt

resolution.description: Video resolution - 480p for faster generation, 720p for balance.
resolution.title: Resolution

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed
